title: Zach King to Create Original Content in New Partnership with The Walt Disney Company

# Zach King to Create Original Content in New Partnership with The Walt Disney Company


[Brand](https://thewaltdisneycompany.com/brand/)


November 18, 2026


3 min. read


*Collaboration Also Brings King’s Signature Illusions to* Disney’s Hexed *,* Star Wars, *and Disney Experiences, plus the Disney+ Debut of King’s* Cardboard Wars


The Walt Disney Company and filmmaker and creator **Zach King** today announced a creative partnership that includes **10 original Illusion Shorts** that King will create exclusively for Disney to distribute, including on **Disney** +. The collaboration will also bring his signature illusions to new content for[Disney+](https://www.disneyplus.com/) and his own channels[inspired by Disney’s Hexed](https://youtube.com/shorts/LRT5ng-SW3g?si=uUnJc3PztcOH8ceW) , *Star Wars* , and other Disney films and experiences. In addition, he will create behind-the-scenes content for Disney’s social platforms, giving fans a look at the filmmaking and visual effects that make his illusions possible. The agreement builds on Disney’s ongoing relationship with King and marks their most extensive collaboration to date.


The deal also includes a Disney+ debut for *Cardboard Wars* , King’s 2026 hour-long tribute to[the original 1977 Star Wars movie](https://thewaltdisneycompany.com/news/star-wars-50th-anniversary-celebration/) , featuring cardboard sets, props and costumes.


“Zach makes the impossible look real, bringing the kind of imagination and originality that has always defined Disney,” said **Asad Ayaz** , Chief Marketing and Brand Officer, The Walt Disney Company. “He brings both a filmmaker’s ingenuity and a fan’s passion to our stories, along with a unique connection with audiences. We want to[build lasting relationships with creators](https://thewaltdisneycompany.com/news/created-in-la-creator-event/) like Zach, giving their ideas room to grow across Disney. That’s what makes this next chapter of our work together so full of possibility.”


Filmmaker and creator Zach King


“I fell in love with filmmaking and storytelling as a young kid, grabbing my parents’ home video camera and teaching myself to edit,” said King. “A lot of my early films were inspired by Disney movies and the behind-the-scenes footage they would show in the DVD featurettes. There was always a sense of magic I would see on the screen, and so I’m thrilled to be working with Disney to continue that magic of filmmaking for the next generation of storytellers.”


King, CEO of **King Studio** , has built a global audience of **more than 185 million followers** across platforms. A pioneer in short-form storytelling, he combines innovative visual effects with family-friendly storytelling in award-winning videos that have generated billions of views worldwide.
